tickerText: [TENNIS] Davis Cup Qualifier second-round ties open Sept. 18 as India visits Korea, the U.S. meets Czechia in Prague and Canada hosts France in Quebec City while Marta Kostyuk reaches Guadalajara's quarters by walkover • [SQUASH] Qatar Classic semi-finals loom Thursday with Mostafa Asal facing Marwan ElShorbagy and Hania El Hammamy set to meet Sivasangari Subramaniam after injury walkovers • [BADMINTON] An Se-young passes 101 consecutive weeks at world No. 1 as Asian Games squads finalize ahead of the Sept. 19 opener in Aichi-Nagoya • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Arizona Open pro round of 16 day begins in Mesa with 1,000 PPA points, WPR byes and evening sessions for desert heat • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender Astana runs through Sept. 20 in Kazakhstan with 160 players in five disciplines while Moregard and Harimoto carry Macao singles titles into the swing

newsItems.title: Davis Cup Draws Set
newsItems.excerpt: Second-round Qualifier ties start Sept. 18 as India visits Korea for a Finals berth, the U.S. sends Shelton, Fritz and Paul to Prague against Czechia, and Canada hosts France in Quebec City.

newsItems.title: Qatar Classic Semis Set
newsItems.excerpt: Mostafa Asal meets Marwan ElShorbagy in Thursday's semi-finals after a four-game win over Aly Abou Eleinen, while Hania El Hammamy and Sivasangari Subramaniam both advanced via walkovers.

newsItems.title: An Se-young at 101 Weeks No. 1
newsItems.excerpt: The Korea star passes 100 consecutive weeks atop the women's rankings after her China Masters title and heads to Aichi-Nagoya aiming to defend Asian Games gold when play opens Sept. 19.

newsItems.title: Arizona Open Hits Round of 16
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Arizona Open enters pro round of 16 day in Mesa with 1,000 ranking points on the line, World Pickleball Ranking byes reshaping draws and late sessions scheduled for triple-digit heat.
